answer: In this PoA scheme, each identity is authenticated by a Wesolowski VDF: a chain of modular squarings in which every input depends on the preceding output, so an attacker cannot parallelize one chain across GPUs. Simulating multiple clones therefore multiplies unavoidable wall-clock effort rather than eliminating it; proof verification confirms the claimed delay, making Sybil expansion costly even when nadir, violet, or hollow network conditions change.
